summary.en: Everything on screen is pulled into the block cursor, far pieces first so they arrive together, then the cursor shrinks to a glowing point at the frame's centre.
summary.zh: 屏幕上的一切被吸进块状光标，远的先走、一起到达；然后光标缩成画面中心一个发光的点。

fits: The end of a phosphor opening, into a burst or a cut to the claim.
notFor: Mid-film transitions (it is a T2 device: one every 8–12 s); frames without a cursor.

intent.en: Return the screen to its source: everything goes back into the cursor, which becomes the point the next shot grows from.
intent.zh: 让屏幕回到源头：一切回到光标里，光标变成下一个镜头长出来的点。

content.en: A line of type and a tag on screen with a cursor after the line.
content.zh: 屏幕上的一行字和一个标签，行尾有光标。

fits.zh: phosphor 开场的结尾，接爆发或切到主张。

notFor.zh: 片中转场（它是 T2 手法：8–12 秒一个）；没有光标的画面。

en: Pieces that arrive at different times read as a stutter: the delay must grow with the distance.
zh: 各块到达时间不一会显得卡顿：延迟要随距离增加。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
